guide: Launch a web app on Product Hunt and use error logging and a ticket board to fix the bugs real users find. You need a working web app, a Product Hunt account, Sentry and Linear.
1. Deploy your web app to a public URL, for example on Vercel, with a database such as Supabase if it needs one.
1. Create a Product Hunt listing with a clear tagline, screenshots and a short demo video, and set the launch date.
1. Add Sentry to your app by installing its SDK for your framework, so every error users hit is logged with where it happened.
1. Set Sentry to alert you when a new error appears, so you hear about problems the day they start.
1. Create a Linear team for the app and turn each real Sentry error into a ticket with the steps to reproduce it.
1. Launch on Product Hunt and watch Sentry as the extra traffic arrives, because bugs that never appeared in your own testing will show up.
1. Fix the tickets in order of how many users each one affects, redeploy, and close them in Linear.
Watch out: Test with your own account before launch day, because the bugs from real traffic only show up once strangers use the app, so have error logging switched on before they arrive.

```
You are helping me prepare a web app for a public launch and set up a way to catch and fix bugs afterwards. My app is <app name>, built with <framework>, hosted on <hosting provider>. I have accounts for Sentry, Linear and Product Hunt.
Please do the following:
1. Add the Sentry SDK for <framework> to my project, with the setup code and where each file goes, and make sure it does not log users' passwords or personal data.
2. Show me how to configure a Sentry alert that emails me when a new error appears.
3. Give me a simple template for a Linear bug ticket: title, steps to reproduce, the Sentry link, how many users are affected, and priority.
4. Write a launch-day checklist covering deployment, environment variables, error logging and a plan for triaging bugs in the first 48 hours.
Keep the setup minimal and explain each step in plain English. Do not add any services beyond Sentry and Linear. Return the code changes first, then the template, then the checklist.
```
Not checked: I wrote this from the transcript only, so I did not check the details of Sentry's or Linear's current setup screens.
